description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeDependentDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and search functionalities related to Employee Dependents in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmployeeDependentDao functionalities including saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee dependents.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, sets up the EmployeeDependentDao instance, and populates test data from fixture YAML.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent record and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent with a specified sequence number and validates data integrity.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Ensures that saving an employee dependent with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests retrieving all dependents for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific employee dependent by employee ID and dependent sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deletion of dependents for an employee and verifies their removal.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Validates search functionality with various filters such as employee number, name, and relationship type.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependentWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the search function with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentCount
methods.description: Verifies counting the number of dependents matching search criteria.
